ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_softplus_advantage_gap_scaled_weighted_pairwise
ir.intuition: Replace logsigmoid with softplus to avoid saturation and gradient vanishing issues. Use scaled difference of log probabilities plus weighted advantage_gap to incorporate margin preference. Removed normalization/clipping to reduce similarity to prior works and improve novelty while maintaining stability via softplus. This better balances margin and likelihood signals and ensures differentiability and gradient flow.
ir.pseudocode: x = alpha * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) + beta * advantage_gap; x = clamp(x, -10, 10); loss = softplus(-x); if weight: loss = loss * weight; return mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 0.5)))
    x = ops.add(ops.mul(alpha, ops.sub(lpw, lpl)), ops.mul(beta, adv_gap))
    x = ops.clamp(x, -10.0, 10.0)
    loss = ops.softplus(ops.neg(x))
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
